ns2:course.label: Introduction to Accounting Research
ns2:course.description: Comparative study of alternative methodologies and conceptual frameworks and their application to selected current research issues central to the development of accounting thought, both theoretical and empirical. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Courses in behavioral science, mathematics, and economics; or equivalent background and admission to the accountancy Ph.D. program; or consent of department.
